# 3Dmol.js 2.5.5

Browser build and licenses preserved from the repository's existing fixed
3dmol@2.5.5 package. Official project: https://3dmol.org/

The born-oppenheimer experiment alone loads this local script. Coordinates and
electron-density samples are local; no external structures or workers are fetched.
The BSD license and third-party notices are in LICENSE and 3Dmol-min.js.LICENSE.txt.
